working_definition: Working (non-ostial) cardiomyocytes of the adult heart; authors gave no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that forms the wall of the adult dorsal vessel. There are 84 of these cells per dorsal vessel (Lehmacher et al., 2012).

justification: FBbt treats cardiomyocytes as cardial cells of the larva and adult (see dorsal vessel wall cell). No specific term for non-ostial working cardial cells exists; adult cardial cell is the parent (it also includes ostial cells, hence broad).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Ostial cell of the adult dorsal vessel.

recommendation: Use adult cardial cell (FBbt:00058240) as a broad match.
